title: OpenCADStudio AC1027 ACIS report and FreeCAD platform-gate refresh
mode: deeper/broader primary-source research and plan refinement
scope: Refresh open-source DWG/DXF peer evidence for the AC1027 ACIS/AcDs path
Reconcile the OpenCADStudio codec lineage and evidence limits
Refine native FreeCAD Linux/Windows qualification boundaries and fast implementation readiness
Preserve deferred external evidence and support-claim restrictions

sources.observation: The issue reports a Windows x86-64 v2026.42 AC1027 drawing whose 3DSOLID record at handle 0x5B87 fails with an array count of 163 while only 137 record bits remain. The reporter says the customer drawing cannot be attached; the report does not establish that the record is valid or reproduce a libdxfrw failure.
The application documents native R14-R2018 DWG/DXF workflows, platform releases, and ACIS entity tessellation; these project claims are not independent semantic qualification.
OpenCADStudio is an ACadRust-derived route. Count app/parser observations under that implementation lineage; same-codec audit/save_verified cannot serve as an independent parser vote.

The maintainer reports repairing an earlier DWG writer failure by preserving the unchanged source AcDs section and associated non-entity data-store links on same-version saves; cited validation is same-project/self-reported and does not establish changed-graph, remapped, cross-version, or semantic B-rep writing.
The documentation says stock DXF importers cannot read ACIS SAT/SAB solids; the C++ importer and optional legacy importer have distinct listed entity subsets, with the latter adding 3DFACE.
FreeCAD converts DWG to DXF before its DXF importer, and the DXF import restrictions therefore apply to the DWG helper route.

The report concerns the DXF-to-DWG export path: Automatic converter fallback may return an output path without checking converter success or output existence. It does not describe the DWG-to-DXF import route.

Current main source confirms convertToDwg() returns the requested output path immediately after communicate() for LibreDWG, ODA, and QCAD branches, while convertToDxf() checks for the output DXF before returning it.

ezdxf can author or retain selected ACIS carriers, but it does not provide a general ACIS B-rep geometry oracle; generated mesh-derived SAT/SAB bytes must be checked against independent analytic expectations.

planImpact.implementationSummary: No production code, test, fixture, or dependency changed. Refined the existing PAR-07/S8 platform-consumer and ACIS/AcDs evidence gates: OpenCADStudio is an ACadRust-lineage optional consumer, issue #1896 is not reproducible without its private DWG, FreeCAD's stock DXF importer cannot qualify ACIS solids, and the Linux/Windows native gate must verify direct converter results and importer-supported entity dispositions.
planImpact.nextImplementation: Diagnose the two outstanding local PAR-140 MPOLYGON boundary-metadata roundtrip assertions, run the focused/owning fast controls, then self-unblock to the next local-ready slice.

method.limitations: All peer findings are advisory and version/route-specific. The OpenCADStudio AC1027 customer DWG is unavailable; no private or external fixture was sought or downloaded. FreeCAD platform results remain pending and its documented ACIS importer limitation prevents using the stock DWG-to-DXF route as an ACIS semantic oracle.
